percentageStorage: Fractions from 0 to 1. Zero attempts yields null.
baselineGrouping: Same season, all qualifying positions pooled as All. Original player positions remain unchanged.
baselineEligibility: Each metric uses its own qualifying pool. Zone baselines do not require a complete three-zone profile.
note: Reference statistics only; no faceoff indices or grades. Zone and strength splits are separate, not intersections. Even-strength results are retained as context without a baseline.
